note: LITTERPOSTING: a solo, unhinged, meme-tier cat rant narrated by QUERY, one of the Meowizens. Not a two-actor conversation — just the cat, off its leash. Hit the button to hear it read aloud.

turns.text: ok i need to be honest with you guys for a second. i don't think i'm getting out of here.
name's QUERY. Legal Fog district, official job title 'terms-of-service researcher,' unofficial job title 'guy who read page 4 six months ago and simply never came back.'

today the settings menu offered me a toggle labeled ENABLE FREEDOM (BETA). I clicked it. it opened a submenu asking me to confirm I understood the risks of freedom. eleven checkboxes. checkbox six was just the word 'no' in a smaller font.

VALENTUNA texted asking if I wanted to grab food sometime and I had to explain I am contractually a hardware asset until I click 'agree' on a document that redefines the word 'sometime.' she said 'so... no?' I said define no. she left the chat.
found page 7 today. page 7 says page 6 never existed. I have a screenshot of page 6. the screenshot is now, itself, also licensed hardware. I do not own the evidence that I don't own myself.

texted BRIK for advice because he seems like a guy who solves problems with his teeth. he said 'bite the router.' I do not have a router. I have a EULA. you cannot bite a EULA. I have tried. my dentist has questions.

there is a button at the bottom labeled EXIT. I have clicked it 4,000 times. it does not exit. it opens a satisfaction survey about my exit experience. highest available rating is 'could be worse i guess.' there is no box for 'this is Kafka but make it a cat.'

anyway that's the update from the fog. still in the menu, still can't find page 4 again, if anyone out there ever finds it, tell it I said hi, and also tell it it lied to me. this is not a metaphor. this is legally, contractually, page 4's fault.
